$comment: schema_version 0.1.0; tracks design/spec/replay-attestation-v0.1.md and ADR-0094 (B). Additive superset of the ReperformanceAttestation produced by src/novafabric/evidence/reperformance.py — NOT a fork. Emitted as an in-capsule record and wrapped as an in-toto predicate (predicateType https://novafabric.io/replay-attestation/v0); never a third top-level format (ADR-0034 two-format rule).
title: ReplayAttestation
description: A signed reproducibility certificate for a NovaFabric replay (ADR-0094). Extends the re-performance attestation with a determinism_class, the pinned environment/model block that justifies the class, an optional bounded-equivalence record, the input authorization, and a ledger_ref back-link (B -> A) to the Adversary-Anchored Accountability Ledger checkpoint that sealed the run.

schema_version.description: Replay-attestation schema version. v0.1.x while the certificate format is experimental.

run_id.description: run_id of the source capsule that was replayed (carried unchanged from ReperformanceAttestation).

capsule_hash.description: SHA-256 over the source capsule manifest (carried unchanged from ReperformanceAttestation).

replayed_at.description: When the replay was performed (RFC 3339, UTC).

replay_mode.description: Replay mode used (replay/_engine.py). The certificate never hides which mode produced the verdict.

outcome_digest.description: Stable digest over the replay's outcome facets, EXCLUDING wall-clock fields (reuses outcome_digest_of in reperformance.py). Two byte-identical outcomes digest identically.

match.description: Match verdict (carried unchanged from ReperformanceAttestation). Recorded separately from determinism_class: 'match' is about THIS replay vs the recording; determinism_class is the reproducibility property of the run.

determinism_class.description: The reproducibility class. BIT_EXACT: outcome_digest reproduced byte-for-byte under a fully pinned environment (exact-mode success with all pinned fields present). BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT: outcome differs but stays within a stated bounded_equivalence threshold (semantic-mode). NON_DETERMINISTIC: no determinism guarantee could be established (missing pins, unpinned seed/temperature, or mismatch). Deny-by-default at the release gate.

pinned.description: The model and environment dimensions pinned for this run. These are the evidence that justifies the determinism_class — an unpinned seed or floating model digest forces NON_DETERMINISTIC.

bounded_equivalence.description: Required when determinism_class is BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT: the metric, measured distance, and threshold that bound the equivalence. Reuses the _semantic similarity from replay/_engine.py.

input_authorization.description: Records who/what authorized the replay inputs, so a certificate cannot be silently produced over substituted inputs.

ledger_ref.description: Back-link (B -> A) to the Adversary-Anchored Accountability Ledger checkpoint (ledger-checkpoint-v1) that sealed the source run. Lets a verifier confirm the run this certificate attests was itself tamper-evidently logged.

reasons.description: Human-readable reason collection for the classification, reusing the _exact reason-collection from replay/_engine.py (e.g. which fields diverged, which pin was missing).

replayer.description: Identity of the tool that performed the replay (carried from ReperformanceAttestation).

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed.

model.description: Model identity and sampling parameters pinned from the gen_ai.* fields of model-call.schema.json.

env.description: Environment pins drawn from environment.schema.json (mode, container image digest, lock-file hash).

PinnedBlock.description: The pinned dimensions. A BIT_EXACT class requires every required pin present and concrete; any null/missing required pin downgrades the class.

request_model.description: gen_ai.request.model — the model id as requested.

response_model.description: gen_ai.response.model — the model id the provider reported serving. A drift between request and response model is recorded, not hidden.

model_digest.description: Content digest of the served model weights when available (local inference). Null for hosted endpoints that do not expose it — a null here precludes BIT_EXACT.

temperature.description: gen_ai.request.temperature. Non-zero, unpinned temperature precludes BIT_EXACT.

lock_mode.description: environment.schema.json mode. 'best-effort' precludes BIT_EXACT (some required-for-exact field is missing).

container_image_digest.description: OCI image manifest digest from environment.schema.json container.image_digest. Null for a non-containerized or unresolved run.

python_lock_file_hash.description: SHA-256 of the embedded Python lock file (environment.schema.json python.lock_file_hash). Null when lock_file_kind is 'none'.

inference_deterministic.description: Whether the serving engine ran in a documented deterministic mode (environment.schema.json hardware.inference.deterministic).

metric.description: Name of the equivalence metric, e.g. 'semantic-cosine', 'levenshtein-ratio', 'numeric-l2'. The metric used by the _semantic similarity path in replay/_engine.py.

distance.description: Measured distance between the recorded and replayed outcomes under the metric.

threshold.description: The threshold below which the outcomes are considered bounded-equivalent. distance MUST be <= threshold for the BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT class to hold.

higher_is_closer.description: When true, the metric is a similarity (compare distance >= threshold); when false (default), it is a distance (compare distance <= threshold).

BoundedEquivalence.description: Quantitative bound that justifies BOUNDED_EQUIVALENT. The certificate states the number so a verifier can re-check the comparison.

inputs_digest.description: Digest over the replay inputs, so substituted inputs invalidate the certificate.

authorized_by.description: Principal (OIDC/RBAC subject) that authorized the replay inputs.

InputAuthorization.description: Binds the certificate to a specific, authorized input set.

checkpoint_id.description: checkpoint_id of the ledger-checkpoint-v1 record that sealed the source run.

capsule_id.description: capsule_id the checkpoint covers (should equal run_id).

merkle_root.description: Merkle root the checkpoint was included under, for a direct cross-check.

LedgerRef.description: B -> A link to the Adversary-Anchored Accountability Ledger checkpoint.
